findings.title: Hardcoded SECRET_KEY found in settings
findings.description: SECRET_KEY is hardcoded in source code. Anyone with access to the repo can forge session cookies, sign malicious tokens, and bypass authentication.
findings.fix: Load SECRET_KEY from an environment variable (e.g. os.environ['SECRET_KEY']) or secret manager.

findings.title: Unauthenticated data access on API endpoint: /api/unprotected-users/
findings.description: Endpoint '/api/unprotected-users/' returned HTTP 200 OK and data payload when queried with no authentication token. APIs must return 401 or 403.
findings.fix: Enforce authentication and permission checks on this endpoint (e.g. IsAuthenticated). Return 401 Unauthorized for missing tokens.

findings.title: API Endpoint relying on global AllowAny: /api/unprotected-users/
findings.description: Endpoint '/api/unprotected-users/' [GET, DELETE] has no explicit permission class and inherits the project's global AllowAny default.
findings.fix: Explicitly assign authentication and permission classes (e.g. permission_classes = [IsAuthenticated]) or require session login.

findings.title: Database dump or SQLite database committed to repository
findings.description: Database file or SQL dump 'db.sqlite3' is committed in the repository, potentially exposing schema structure, customer data, and credential hashes.
findings.fix: Remove database dump from source control, add database file extensions to .gitignore, and purge from git history.

findings.title: Django DEBUG set to True
findings.description: DEBUG mode is enabled. Detailed error pages expose stack traces, settings, and internal variables to users.
findings.fix: Set DEBUG = False or load from environment variable (e.g. os.getenv('DJANGO_DEBUG', 'False').lower() in ('true', '1')).

findings.title: Hardcoded credential: Generic Bearer Secret
findings.description: Potential Generic Bearer Secret pattern discovered in file 'drf_sample/settings.py'.
findings.fix: Revoke and rotate exposed credential immediately. Utilize environment variables or vault storage.

findings.title: Missing CsrfViewMiddleware in Django MIDDLEWARE
findings.description: CsrfViewMiddleware is missing. POST, PUT, and DELETE forms and API requests are unprotected against Cross-Site Request Forgery.

findings.title: CSRF_COOKIE_SECURE is disabled
findings.description: CSRF_COOKIE_SECURE = False allows CSRF tokens to be transmitted over unencrypted HTTP connections.
findings.fix: Set CSRF_COOKIE_SECURE = True in production settings.

findings.title: Missing Content-Security-Policy header
findings.description: The response header Content-Security-Policy is not set, leaving users vulnerable to Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) and data injection.
findings.response_detail:
Status: 404
Headers: {'date': 'Sun, 27 Sep 2026 14:56:46 GMT', 'server': 'WSGIServer/0.2 CPython/3.11.15', 'content-type': 'text/html; charset=utf-8', 'content-length': '2500'}

findings.title: Missing SecurityMiddleware in Django MIDDLEWARE
findings.description: SecurityMiddleware is absent. Security headers (HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, SSL redirect) are not enforced by Django.
findings.fix: Add 'django.middleware.security.SecurityMiddleware' near the top of MIDDLEWARE.

findings.title: Missing X-Frame-Options header
findings.description: The X-Frame-Options header is missing, allowing pages to be framed by malicious sites for Clickjacking attacks.

findings.title: Missing rate limiting on API endpoints (/api/public-status/)
findings.description: Burst of 16 rapid sequential requests to '/api/public-status/' succeeded without 429 throttling or rate-limiting headers.
findings.fix: Configure global or endpoint rate limiting (e.g. django-ratelimit, DRF ScopedRateThrottle, or Nginx limit_req).

findings.title: SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE is disabled
findings.description: SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE = False allows session cookies to be transmitted over unencrypted HTTP connections.
findings.fix: Set SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE = True in production settings.

findings.title: Unprotected API Endpoint: /api/public-status/
findings.description: Endpoint '/api/public-status/' [GET] exposes functionality without authentication or permission verification.
findings.fix: Explicitly assign authentication and permission classes (e.g. permission_classes = [IsAuthenticated]) or require session login.

findings.title: Missing X-Content-Type-Options header
findings.description: The X-Content-Type-Options header is missing. Browsers may MIME-sniff the response, leading to unexpected script execution.

findings.title: Server and framework version disclosure in HTTP headers
findings.description: Server exposes version signatures: Server: 'WSGIServer/0.2 CPython/3.11.15', X-Powered-By: ''. This aids attackers in fingerprinting known CVEs.
findings.fix: Strip or suppress Server and X-Powered-By header banners in web server / reverse proxy configuration.

findings.title: pip-audit scanner not found in PATH
findings.description: pip-audit binary is not installed in current environment. Dependency CVE assessment could not run.
findings.fix: Install pip-audit with 'pip install pip-audit' or run via RepoGuard Docker container.
